spans.s:
विल् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (विलति)
1 To cover,
conceal.
--2 To break, divide. {vII.v}
{c10c} U. (वेलयति-ते) To throw, send
forth.

To see, observe,
perceive, notice.
--2 To characterize,
distinguish.
--3 To be confused, be
bewildered; निर्व्यापारविलक्षितानि
सांत्वय बलानि

विलक्ष a.
1 Having no
characteristic or distinguishing marks.
--2 Bewildered, embarrassed.
--3
Surprised, astonished.
--4 Ashamed,
abashed, disconcerted; गोत्रेषु
स्खलितस्तदा भवति च व्रीडाविलक्षश्चिरं
Ś. 6. 4.
--5 Forced, unnatural,
embarrassed (as a smile);
विलक्षस्मितस्फुरितैर्दशनांशुभिः

विलक्षण a.
1 Having no
characteristic or distinguishing marks.
--2 Different, other.
--3 Strange,
extraordinary, unusual.
--4 Possessed
of inauspicious marks.
--णं
1 A
vain or useless state.
--2 Perceiving,
observing.

विलक्षित p. p.
1 Distinguished,
perceived, seen, discovered.
--2
Discernible by.
--3 Dismayed, perplexed,
embarrassed, puzzled.
--4 Vexed,
annoyed.
--5 Undistinguished.

विलग् {c1c} P. To stick or adhere to,
cling to.

--3 Gone by, elapsed (as time).
--4
Thin, slender, delicate; मध्येन सा
वेदिविलग्नमध्या

.
--ग्नं
1 The waist.
--2 The hips.
--3
The rising of constellations.

To pass or spring
over, traverse; निवेशयमास
विलंघिताध्वा

; 16. 32; Śi. 12. 24,
8. 26.
--2 To violate, transgress,
overstep, disregard, neglect; गतुं प्रवृत्ते
समयं विलंध्य

.
--5 To
give up, abandon, leave aside; मनो
बबंधान्यरसान् विलंघ्य सा

.
--7
To cause to fast.
--8 To overcome,
surmount.
--9 To offend, insult.

विलंघित p. p.
1 Passed over or
beyond, gone over.
--2 Transgressed.
--3 Surpassed, excelled.
--4
Overcome, defeated.

To say, speak.
--2 To
lament, moan, bewail, cry, weep;
विललाप विकीर्णमूर्घजा

; तमिह वृथा किं विलपामि Gīt {3}
--3 To prattle, talk idly, babble.

1 Talking.
--2 Talking
idly, chattering, prattle
--3
Lamenting, wailing; विलपनविनोदोप्यसुलभः

.
--4 The sediment of any
oily substance.

विलापः Wailing, lamentation, a
wail, moan; लंकास्त्रीणां पुनश्चक्रे
विलापाचार्यकं शरैः

To hang down,
hang from, be suspended from;

.
--2 To set, decline (as the
sun &c.).
--3 To stay or lag behind,
stay or remain, wait, stand still,
तां प्राङ्मुखीं तत्र निवेश्य तन्वीं क्षणं
व्यलबंत पुरो निषण्णाः

.
--4 To
delay, be retarded; विलांबितफलैः
कालं निनाय स मनोरथैः

To delay, detain.
--2 To put off,
retard, procrastinate, postpone.
--3
To waste, lose.

1 Hanging over,
pendulousness.
--2 Tardiness, delay,
procrastination.

1 Hanging down,
depending.
--2 Delay, procrastination; न
करु नितंबिनि गमनविलंबनं

; or
तन्मुग्धे विफलं विलंबनमसौ रम्योऽ
भिसारक्षणः ibid.

विलंबित p. p.
1 Hanging,
depending.
--2 Pendent, pendulous.
--3
Depending on, closely connected
with.
--4 Tardy, delayed, retarded.
--5 Slow (as time in music).
--तं
Delay.
--तं ind. Slowly, tardily.

.
--2 Delaying, dilatory,
being slow; भवति विलंबिनि
विगलितलज्जा विलपति रोदिति वासकसज्जा

1 Dissolution,
liquefaction.
--2 Destruction, death, end;
नयतु मामात्ममोंऽगेषु विलयमंबा

.
--3 Destruction or dissolution of the
world; (विलयं गम् to be dissolved,
to end, to be terminated, दिवसोऽ
नुमित्रमगपद्विलयं Śi. 9. 17).

1 Dissolving, liquefying,
dissolution.
--2 Corroding.
--3
Removing, taking away.
--4
Attenuating.
--5 An attenuant.

To shine, flash,
glitter; वियति च विलिलास
तद्वदिंदुर्विलसति चंद्रमसो न यद्वदन्यः

.
--2 To appear,
arise, become manifest; प्रेम विलसति
महत्तदहो Śi. 15. 14; 9. 87.
--3 To
sport, amuse oneself, play, frolic
about sportively; कापि चपला
मधुरिपुणा विलसति युवतिरधिकगुणा

.
--4 To sound, echo,
reverberate.
--5 To act upon, work
upon, show oneself; (खेदः)
त्वयि विलसति तुल्यं वल्लभालोकनेन

.
--6 To move about, dart, shoot
up wards.

विलसत् pres. a. (न्ती f.)
1
Glittering, shining, bright.
--2
Flashing, darting.
--3 Waving.
--4
Sportive, playful; see विलस् above.

विलसित p. p.
1 Glittering,
shining, gleaming.
--2 Appeared,
manifested.
--3 Sportive, wanton.
--तं
1 Glittering, gleaming.
--2 A gleam,
flash; रोधोभुवां मुहुग्मुत्र हिरण्मयीनां
भासस्तडिद्विलसितानि विडंबयंति

.
--3 Appearance,
manifestation; as in अज्ञानविलसितं &c.
--4 Sport, play, dalliance, amorous
or wanton gesture (fig. also);
अतिपिशुनानि चैकांतनिष्टुरस्य दवैह कस्य
विलसितानि K.
--5 Action or gesture
in general.
--6 Effect, fruit, result;
[]

1 Sport, play, pastime.
--2 Amorous pastime, diversion,
pleasure; as in विलासमेखला

;
so विलासकाननं, विलासमंदिरं &c.
--3
Coquetry, dalliance, affectation,
wantonness, graceful movement or play,
any feminine gesture indicative of
amorous sentiment; Ś. 2. 2;
कविकुलगुरुः कालिदासो विलासः
P.

.
--5 Flash,
gleam.
--Comp.
--काननं a
pleasuregrove.
--मंदिर a pleasure-house.
--चेष्टितं amorous movement;

विलासवती A wanton or amorous
woman;

विलासिका A drama in one act
full of love-incidents; it is
thus defined in S. D.:
--शृंगारबहुलैकांका
दशलास्यांगसंयुता । विदूषकविटभ्यां च
पीठमर्देन भूषिता । हीना गर्भविमर्षाभ्यां संधिभ्यां
हीननायका । स्वल्पवृत्ता सुमेपथ्या विख्याता सा
विलासिका 552.

विलासिन् a. (नीं f.) Sportive,
playful, dallying, wanton, coquettish;

. --m.
1 A sensualist,
voluptuary, an amorous person;
उपमानमभूद्विलासिनां करणं यत्तव कांतिमतया

.
--2 Fire.
--3 The moon.
--4 A snake.
--5 An epithet of
Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu.
--6 Of Śiva.
--7 Of
the god of love.

1 A woman (in general).
--2 A coquettish or wanton woman;
हरिघि मग्धवधूनि करे विलासिनि विलसति
केलिपरे

1 A cat (= बिडाल).
--2
An instrument, a machine.

To write, inscribe.
--2 To draw, paint, delineate, portray;
विलिखति रहसि कुरंगमदेन
भवंतमसमशरभूतं

.
--3 To scratch, scrape,
tear up; मंदं शब्दायमानो विलिखति
शयनादुत्थितः क्ष्मां खुरण K.

.
--4
To implant, infix; तावंतोपि
विलिख्यंते हृदये शाकशकवः

1 Scratching, scraping,
making a mark or furrow.
--2
[]
Digging.
--3 Uprooting.
--4 Dividing,
splitting.

To smear, anoint.
rub on; तथाहि नृत्याभिनयक्रियाच्युतं
विलिप्यते मौलिभिरंबरौकसां

; 15. 6; Śi. 16. 62.
--2 To
pollute, defile, taint, contaminate.

विलिप्त p. p.
1 Anointed,
besmeared, smeared over.
--2 Polluted,
stained, defiled.

1 An unguent, an ointment.
--2 Mortar.
--3 Plaster (in general).
--4 Anointing, plastering.

1 Smearing, anointing.
--2
An ointment, unguent, any
cosmetic or perfume for the body (such
as saffron, sandal &c); न स्नानं न
विलेपनं न कुसुमं नालंकृता मूर्धजाः

1 A woman scented with
perfumes
--2 A woman beautifully
dressed or attired (सुवेशा).
--3
Ricegruel.

To cling or stick
to, adhere to.
--2 To rest on, settle
down or alight on; पुरोऽस्य यावन्न
भुविव्यलीयत Śi. 1. 12.
--3 To be
dissolved, to melt away, be absorbed
in; विलिल्ये यत्कुक्षिस्थितशिखिनि
वातापिवपुषा

; 7. 14.
--4 To
vanish, disappear.
--5 To perish. {vII.v}
{c9c} P. To melt, liquefy.

विलीन p. p.
1 Sticking to, clung
or attached to.
--2 Perched or
settled on, alighting on.
--3 Contiguous
to, in contact with.
--4 Melted,
dissolved, liquefied.
--5 Disappeared,
vanished.
--6 Dead, perished.

To agitate, stir
up, toss about.
--2 To disturb,
confuse.
--3 To turn over, upset.

विलोडनं Agitating, shaking about,
stirring up, churning; Śi. 14. 83.

विलोडित p. p.
1 Shaken,
churned, stirred, agitated.
--2 Rolling on
the ground.
--तं Butter-milk.

To break off, pull
out, cut off.
--2 To seize, plunder,
rob, carry off.
--3 To mar, spoil,
impair.
--4 (a) To destroy, ruin,
cause to disappear;
[]
प्रियमत्यंतविलुप्तदर्शनं

‘for ever lost to view’.
(b) To eat up; क्रव्याद्भिरंगलतिका
नियतं विलुप्ता

.
--5
To wipe or rub off. --Pass. To be
destroyed or lost, to perish,
disappear; जराविलुप्तमानावमानचिंतः Dk.

विलुप्त p. p.
1 Broken or torn off;

.
--2 Seized, snatched away,
carried off
--3 Robbed, plundered.
--4 Destroyed, ruined.
--5 Impaired,
mutilated.

विलुंपकः^1 A thief, robber, ravisher^2.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: per AP quote from Bhag.

.
[2] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk on 20210104. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20.

1 Taking away, carrying
off, seizure, plunder.
--2 Loss,
destruction, disappearance.

1 Cutting off.
--2 Carrying
away.
--3 Destroying, destruction.

विलुभ् {c4c} P. To be disturbed or
deranged; be disordered;

To allure, entice,
attract; स्मर यावन्न विलाभ्यसे दिवि

.
--2 To divert, amuse,
entertain; क्वदृष्टिं विलोभयामि Ś. 6;
ललितलताविलोभ्यमाननयनो भवानुत्कठां
विनोदयतु

1 Enticing, alluring.
--2
An allurement, a temptation,
seduction; प्रयुज्य सामाचरितं विलोभनं भयं
विभेदाय धियः प्रदर्शितं

To move to and
fro.
--2 To shake, make tremulous.
--3 To disorder, derange, dishevel
(as hair). --Caus. To agitate, stir,
disturb.

विलुलित p. p.
1 Moving to and fro,
unsteady, shaken, tossed about,
tremulous;

विलून p. p. Cut off, lopped off,
clipt, cut asunder.

To see, behold,
look at, perceive; विलोक्य
वृद्धोक्षमधिष्ठितं त्वया महाजनः स्मेरमुखो भविष्यति

; 6. 59.
--2 To
search for, look out for.

विलोकित p. p.
1 Seen, observed,
[]
viewed, beheld.
--2 Examined,
thought about.
--तं A look, glance;
Ś. 2. 3.

विलोम a. (मी f.)
1 Inverted,
reverse, inverse, contrary, opposite.
--2 Produced in the reverse order.
--3
Backward.
--मः
1 Reverse order,
inversion.
--2 A dog.
--3 A snake.
--4
N. of Varuṇa.
--मं A waterwheel,
machine for raising water from
a well.
--Comp.
--उत्पन्न, --ज, --जात,
--वर्ण a. ‘born in the reverse order’;
i. e. born of a mother whose caste
is superior to the father's; cf.
प्रतिलोमज also.
--क्रिया, --विधिः {1} a reverse
action. {2} a rule of inversion (in
math.).
--जिह्वः an elephant.

विलोल a.
1 Shaking about,
trembling, tremulous, unsteady,
rolling, waving, tossing about;
पृषतीषु विलोलमीक्षितं

.
--2 Loose,
disordered, dishevelled (as hair);
दधती विलोलकबरीकमाननं

विलोहित a.
1 Of a purple
colour.
--2 Reddish, red; धनुर्धरः
कोपविलोहिताक्षः

.
--तः N. of
Rudra.
--ता One of the tongues of
fire.
